messages.content: 你能計算我進行的科學實驗中空氣在恆壓下的熱容量嗎？我有一個容積為2.5立方公尺的容器，並能保持溫度在300開氏度。我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗，接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗。我在所有這些實驗中都使用空氣。你能提供這三種不同條件下的熱容量嗎？

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3. This is a float type value.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

So we have 3 conditions: (V=2.5, T=300°C), (V=2.5, T=350°C), (V=1.5, T=300°C). Or maybe they intend to do all combinations? They said "I will repeat this experiment at higher temperature 350°C and next at lower volume 1.5 m^3 repeating the experiment." That could mean they will do 3 experiments: (2.5, 300°C), (2.5, 350°C), (1.5, 300°C). They didn't mention 1.5, 350°C. So we only compute those three.

We need to call the function thrice. Provide gas="air" each time. Use temp in Kelvin. So we need to convert 300°C to 573.15 K, 350°C to 623.15 K. Then call function with volume 2.5, temp 573.15, gas "air". Then volume 2.5, temp 623.15, gas "air". Then volume 1.5, temp 573.15, gas "air".
